metadata.methodology: 15 Intelligence metrics normalized [0,1], averaged → composite ability; Pareto = non-dominated by per-request cost; Both axes rank-mapped (index/exponential mapping) for uniform [0,1] distribution
metadata.arithmetic: All intermediate calculations use fractions.Fraction for exact rational arithmetic; only converted to float at chart coordinates and JSON output

per_request_cost.non_reasoning: Output_tokens = (Total - TTFT) × Speed; Cost = (In × InPrice + Out × OutPrice) / 1M
per_request_cost.reasoning_with_time: Output_tokens = (Total - TTFT) × Speed; Cost = (In × InPrice + Out × OutPrice) / 1M
per_request_cost.reasoning_no_time: Output_tokens = Total × Speed; Cost = (In × InPrice + Out × OutPrice) / 1M
